name: Focus
line: The page as a microscope: round fields of stained cells, drawn on canvas, come into focus as they reach the middle of the screen; the four IARC groups are the same slide at four levels of focus (Group 3 blurred, never empty), the lesson is two equally sharp fields of 1,000 cells in which 100 to 120 or 4 to 5 take the stain, and the two explorers are drawn from their data as stained specimens.
notes: Eosin pink (#E07BA5) is used only inside the fields, never for text. The cells are drawn for this page (packed Voronoi cells with nuclei), not a real slide. The two networks are drawn from media/graph.json and media/chronic-graph.json with a small stable force layout written in the page, because kit/net.js's layout diverges on the chronic graph (its largest node has 81 links). Without JavaScript the fields show a quiet stained texture and the explorers' own network pictures in greyscale; with reduced motion every field is still and sharp (the four group fields keep their fixed focus levels, which carry meaning). Onest has Cyrillic; Petrona has Latin and Vietnamese only.
